title: Lago vs Chargebee: Choose Billing for the Product You Will Sell Next
summary: Compare Lago Cloud and Chargebee for AI usage, credits, self-serve plans and enterprise contracts. See what changes when you launch a new price.
body_markdown:
**If your SaaS or AI product adds usage and credits to self-serve plans, or sells negotiated contracts, start with Lago Cloud.** Both platforms can bill subscriptions and usage. The more revealing question is what happens when you launch a new AI feature or change its price. Lago connects usage events to billable metrics, prices, prepaid credits and invoices. Its ongoing wallet balance includes processed usage and typically refreshes in under a second after an event lands; the application still enforces any hard spend limit.[Chargebee also documents a usage ingestion pipeline](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/configure-prepaid-credits) that rates metered events against prepaid credits. Compare where your pricing rules live and how much code each workflow needs.


## The pricing change that exposes the difference


Suppose you add a new AI model. Input and output tokens have different rates; enterprise customers have negotiated prices; customers can prepay for usage. Your application sends events with the model and other dimensions. In Lago, you can define billable usage as a[sum, count, unique count, latest value or time-weighted amount](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/aggregation-types/overview) , with[expressions](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/billable-metrics/sql-expressions) for calculations from event properties.[Charge filters](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/plans/charges/charges-with-filters) set rates by model or region, and[customer-level overrides](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/subscriptions/assign-plan) carry negotiated terms. Lago supports[standard, graduated, package, volume, percentage, graduated-percentage and dynamic charge models](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/plans/charges/charge-models/dynamic) . Configure the charge that matches what you sell, then inspect the invoice.


Chargebee has[metered features and multiple aggregation methods](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/usage-based-billing/included-usage-with-hard-cap) , along with[tiered, volume and package pricing](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/kb/product-catalog/what-are-pricing-models-available-for-plans-addons-charges-in-chargebee) . A feature count will not tell you which system is easier to change. Ask both vendors to add the model, change one rate and show where the calculation lives. Then check the prepaid-credit path. Lago applies eligible credits against the rated charges and updates the ongoing balance as events are processed, with alerts and automatic top-ups. Chargebee also documents two prepaid-credit paths: your app can send credit debits to its ledger, or Chargebee can rate raw metered events against configured credit prices. Confirm which path and features are enabled in your account. In either system, your application decides when to stop product access.


**Lago is the developer-first option in this comparison.**[Lago Cloud](https://getlago.com/pricing) manages the service, while engineers build with a[documented API, OpenAPI spec, SDKs, signed webhooks, CLI and MCP server](https://getlago.com/developers) . They can run a[local AI billing demo](https://github.com/getlago/lago/tree/main/examples/agentic-ai-demo) from event to verified charge, then inspect the[open-source engine](https://github.com/getlago/lago) when a calculation needs explaining or extending. Self-hosting is also available. The team that will maintain billing can test the exact pricing change before it becomes a production dependency.


## Run four tests before you choose


1. **Self-serve signup and change.** Have a customer buy a monthly plan, upgrade midcycle, use a paid AI feature and miss a card payment. Lago handles[subscriptions and plan changes](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/subscriptions/upgrades-downgrades) through its API or dashboard; its[portal](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/customers/customer-portal) shows invoices, usage and credits. Your product owns the signup and plan-change screens. Chargebee provides[hosted checkout](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/hosted-checkout) and a[self-serve portal](https://www.chargebee.com/docs/billing/2.0/hosted-capabilities/self-serve-portal) . Compare the complete journey, not the checkout screen alone.
2. **A new AI price.** Send representative token events, add another model and change its rate. Show the resulting charge, wallet balance, alert or top-up, and invoice preview. Record each setting, API call and application-code change. If simultaneous jobs require a hard spend cap, test that explicitly: Lago's ongoing balance is not a reservation. Test Chargebee's documented credit ledger or usage-ingestion path against the authorization behavior your app needs.
3. **A negotiated contract.** Start with an annual platform fee, one million included API calls per month, $2 per additional thousand calls and prepaid AI credits. At 1.25 million calls, the overage is $500 before tax. Change the included allowance midterm and show the order, subscription, credits and next invoice. Lago's[Quotes & Order Forms](https://getlago.com/platform/quotes) is a Premium add-on that carries agreed terms into billing; signing takes place outside Lago, so confirm access and the handoff in the proposal. Ask Chargebee to run the same amendment through its[contract workflow](https://www.chargebee.com/solutions/usecases/contract-billing) .
4. **Finance and collections.** Reconcile invoice, fee and credit-note[exports](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/invoicing/export) to the two journeys. Ask Lago's[Finance Assistant (beta)](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/finance-assistant) , in Lago or through the[MCP server](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/mcp-server) in your chosen client, about overdue invoices and credit consumption; verify its answer against source records. Have Lago's[Dunning Agent](https://getlago.com/docs/guide/ai-agents/dunning-agent) show a failed card and a partial payment in the mode you would use. Its documented Cloud-connected modes prepare drafts for a person; automated sending and retries run in a self-hosted app. If statutory revenue recognition is mandatory, have finance compare Chargebee's separate[RevRec product](https://www.chargebee.com/pricing) with Lago's Premium revenue recognition private beta, which produces draft accrual reports that finance must reconcile.


Score the same four tests on invoice accuracy, time to change a price, application work, customer visibility and finance reconciliation. Get a written proposal naming access, event limits, support and total cost for your deployment. The examples above are illustrative, not vendor quotes.


## Make the call


**Choose Lago Cloud when pricing flexibility, prepaid AI credits and developer control matter across self-serve and enterprise accounts.** The decisive proof is a working change from a new usage event to a customer balance and invoice, without rebuilding credit math in your application. Before switching, test the steps your team depends on: how customers pay, whether credits can be set aside before they use a paid AI feature, and how Finance closes the month. Run one sample month in Lago Cloud alongside your current system, without charging customers twice, then compare usage, credit balances and invoice totals.


If you are choosing a billing platform for your next AI pricing change, test it with Lago Cloud. Bring a new model, a customer-specific rate, or a trial that ramps into paid usage. Lago Cloud already gives you prepaid credits, automatic top-ups, and an ongoing wallet balance. In a demo, preview how reusable pricing across plans, scheduled rate changes, and phased prices would work for your business. We will show the credit flow and map your scenario to the invoice, so you can judge Lago against what you actually plan to sell.


[Book a Lago demo](https://getlago.com/book-a-demo) with your current plan and one proposed pricing change. If you sell enterprise deals, bring an anonymized order form too. Ask us to show the effect on the wallet and invoice.


Lago Cloud is the managed option described here. If you prefer to run Lago on your own infrastructure, we also offer[Premium self-hosted](https://getlago.com/pricing) and an[open-source edition](https://github.com/getlago/lago) .
